hero.eyebrow: A little context behind the work
hero.heading: A Little More About Me.
hero.intro: I'm Truong Duy Minh, a recent Information Technology graduate majoring in Software Engineering. I'm working toward a career in Business Analysis, where I can help turn business needs into clear, practical software requirements.
hero.portraitLabel: Portrait placeholder for Truong Duy Minh
hero.portraitCaption: A real portrait can be added here later.

story.label: My story
story.heading: From building software to understanding why it should be built.
paragraphs: Studying Software Engineering gave me a foundation in how software is designed and developed. Along the way, I became just as curious about the questions that come before implementation: what problem are we solving, who needs the solution, and what would make it useful?

That curiosity led me toward Business Analysis. I enjoy listening for needs, asking clarifying questions, and shaping what I learn into requirements and process models that a team can discuss and act on.
I'm at the beginning of my career, and I want to keep growing my ability to connect business expectations with technical implementation through thoughtful analysis and collaboration.
story.asideQuote: Start with the problem. Make the solution understandable.
